# Ian Gorst

Ian Gorst is the current Deputy of [District 1](https://flow.je/elections/district-1) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2005.

Ian Gorst has participated in 6 elections since 2002:

- [**2005 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/ian-gorst#e7)

  Elected as Deputy of St Clement with 64.7% of the ballot.
- [**2008 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/ian-gorst#e12)

  Elected as Deputy of St Clement with 65.4% of the ballot.
- [**2011 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/ian-gorst#e16)

  Elected as Senator with 55.3% of the ballot.
- [**2014 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/ian-gorst#e19)

  Elected as Senator with 56.3% of the ballot.

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2014/ian-gorst-2/)
  - [2014 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20141219182259/http://www.gorst.je/)
  - [2014 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pX9OLWlP_Ec)
- [**2018 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/ian-gorst#e41)

  Elected as Senator with 44.6% of the ballot.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/ian-gorst-3/)
  - [2018 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qsh60pc8x5A)
  - [2018 Tom Gruchy Interview Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_3qIt22IVPI)
  - [2018 Bailiwick Express Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=njhz_I9sPhQ)
  - [2018 ITV Video](http://www.itv.com/news/channel/2018-04-10/jsy2018-iangorst/)
- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/ian-gorst#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 1 with 59.7% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/ian-gorst/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=17vj4hvArSY)
  - [2022 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20220616075637/https://gorst.je/manifesto/)
  - [2022 Jersey Evangelical Alliance Survey](https://www.jerseyevangelicalalliance.org.je/s/Ian-Gorst-Deputy-St-Mary-St-Ouen-and-St-Peter-JEA-Questionnaire.pdf)

Ian Gorst has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Senators Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/02/02/external-relations-minister-ian-gorst-announces-plan-to-run-as-senator/)\]

## Election History

**Ian Gorst was elected as Deputy of St Clement in 2005**.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Gerard Baudains](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/gerard-baudains)** |  | 974 | 67.7% |
| 2 | **Ian Gorst** |  | 930 | 64.7% |
| 3 | [Mike Taylor](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mike-taylor) |  | 671 | 46.7% |

1,438 ballots (inc. 3 spoilt papers)
